_why: Row 2953 (--onto-default in handoff_commit.py) + status_entries porcelain XY slicing.

mutations.name: status-entries-partitions-on-leading-space
mutations._mechanism: An unstaged modification to a tracked file (such as docs/learnings.md or docs/skill-candidates.md) has porcelain prefix ' M ', so f.partition(' ') yields path='M docs/...' and misses the path.

mutations.name: onto-default-skips-head-vs-default-divergence-check
mutations._mechanism: Without the blob comparison between HEAD and refs/heads/<default>, --onto-default overwrites newer default-branch commits or sweeps earlier feature commits onto the default branch.

mutations.name: onto-default-skips-dirty-default-worktree-check
mutations._mechanism: Without checking status_entries(db_wt), copying from a linked worktree overwrites uncommitted edits to the same file in the default-branch worktree.

mutations.name: onto-default-does-not-restore-feature-checkout
mutations._mechanism: If _restore_to_head is skipped after committing to refs/heads/<default>, the feature checkout remains dirty on the committed path.

mutations.name: onto-default-does-not-remove-untracked-file-from-feature-checkout
mutations._mechanism: When a brand-new untracked file is committed onto <default> from a feature checkout, leaving it on disk leaves the feature checkout dirty.
